description: The headless dropdown list core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvDropDownList is one styled renderer over createDropdownList, which owns open and close state, a roving active index over the enabled options, the select keyboard model and ARIA, exposed as triggerProps, listboxProps and optionProps. The same core drives the styled component and a custom trigger-plus-menu render sharing one value.

faq.question: How are disabled options handled?
faq.answer: The active index only moves over enabled options, so arrow keys skip a disabled entry and optionProps marks it with aria-disabled; your render can style it however it likes.

faq.question: How do I open the list from my own trigger?
faq.answer: Spread triggerProps() on any button. It wires click, ArrowDown to open, aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, and the core's open flag tells your render when to show the list.

faq.question: Is type-ahead part of the core?
faq.answer: Yes. Typing letters while the trigger or list has focus moves the active option to the next label starting with them, as a native select does.
